title: Club Membership: employer-linked discount candidate for a recurring dues charge
content:
## Scope
This document states one of the two candidate discount percentages that may reduce a Club Membership recurring dues charge: the discount tied to an active corporate wellness enrollment.

## Rule
Where the member is the customer of an active corporate wellness enrollment, that linked employer partnership tier's own discount percentage is one candidate percentage available to reduce the recurring dues charge. This candidate applies only while that corporate wellness enrollment's own status is active and the member is its own customer; it is 0 percent where no such active enrollment exists.

## Condition table
| Member's corporate wellness enrollment | Employer-linked candidate percentage |
|---|---|
| Linked and active | That partnership tier's own discount percentage |
| Linked but not active | 0 percent |
| No linked enrollment | 0 percent |

## Points of judgement
A member linked to two different corporate wellness enrollments over time carries this candidate percentage only from whichever such enrollment is currently active; a lapsed enrollment contributes nothing to this candidate percentage even if it was active in the past.
